notes: Single compact deliverable program whose own source is the size-constrained artifact: gzip(source) <= 400 bytes and raw <= 750 bytes while the program must stay generic across hidden render specs (different dimensions, ramps, coefficients; same formula) and render frames byte-exactly. The tight caps force genuine size engineering (compact arg handling, single-expression rendering, self-measurement via __file__) and the anti-embedding rules forbid shipping pixel data; naive verbose implementations and any embedded-frame approach exceed the cap. Hidden cases keep the identical caps so a visible-only program cannot pass. Rubric weights reasoning_depth (self-referential size report + generic formula), resource_pressure (hard byte ceilings), quantitative_correctness (byte-exact frames and size numbers), plus hidden-case generalization and adversarial (narrow/thin frames). Totals bucket to hard.
